## I build AI products and ship them

I founded an AI startup, built the whole thing myself, and **sold it along with its technology.**
Web platform, voice AI, RAG pipelines, citation engine, cloud infra. All of it.

That is the short version. The longer one: six years of applied AI across healthcare,
human computer interaction, and LLM products, with a full stack background that means
I own the model, the pipeline, the API, the infra, and the interface a real person touches.

I like problems where the signal is messy and the user is real. Voice as a vital sign.
EEG as a game controller. A chatbot that has to be kind to a dementia patient.

### The last few years

| | |
| :-- | :--- |
| 🚀 | **Founded and sold an AI startup.** Full stack product with voice and audio AI, RAG over a large document corpus, citation engine. Every technical call was mine. |
| 🧠 | **Interim AI Lead at Juztina.** Production LLM pipelines on Azure and AWS. Churn down 10%, feature adoption up 25%. |
| 🎙️ | **AI Engineer at Amplifier Health.** Deep learning for disease detection from voice, deployed on GCP Cloud Run. |
| 🏥 | **Lead ML Engineer at CIUSSS West-Central Montreal.** Precision medicine AI, federated learning across 10+ institutions, 30% faster deployments. |
| 📍 | **Montreal, QC.** Open to conversations about applied AI, LLM infrastructure, and health tech. |

<details>
<summary><b>What that actually looked like</b></summary>

<br>

**Stealth startup.** Architected and shipped a full stack AI product: web platform, voice AI,
audio features. Built RAG pipelines, a citation engine, and domain tuned LLM workflows over a
large document corpus. Led every technical decision across AI architecture, cloud, and reliability.
Sold the company and its technology.

**Juztina.** Designed and maintained scalable AI pipelines and data infrastructure, optimizing LLM
performance in production. Shipped AI features that cut churn 10% and raised feature adoption 25%.
Ran services across Azure and AWS EC2.

**Amplifier Health.** Put deep learning models into production for real medical use, including
Parkinson's detection from voice. Deployed on GCP Cloud Run and AWS EC2.

**CIUSSS and Lady Davis Institute.** Led precision medicine AI in the mental health department.
Built automated ML pipelines that improved deployment efficiency 30%. Developed federated learning
over multimodal clinical data with 10+ global institutions in the DREAM BIG consortium.
Hardened models against data leakage.

**Huawei.** Applied AI for IoT and wearables in smart homes. New features for phones, homes,
and cars with 20% lower latency. Prototyped and demoed concepts for product integration and
contributed to patents. Won the Outstanding Team Award of the Canadian Research Centre.

**UQO and Bruyere.** Built a virtual companion for patients in Unity on the GPT-4 API.
Improved speech recognition and text to speech, raising user engagement 55%.

</details>
